title: 60 series 1hdt swap help
ai_summary: A 1986 FJ60 being built as a SEMA 2023 vehicle received a turbocharged 1HD-T (UFI 18G turbo) with a water-air intercooler and H55F 5-speed manual, plus a new transfer case. On initial startup the builder saw white smoke and engine shaking, which forum members attributed to air trapped in the fuel system rather than a fundamental swap defect.

complications.detail: White smoke and engine shaking on first startup, diagnosed as air in the fuel system during priming
Questions raised about secondary fuel filter setup and glow plug function for cold starts
